inputs.name: PairingController.constructor.store
inputs.description: HostStorageAdapter checked before the rate limit and action dispatch. If host() is falsy, handle returns 404 not-found immediately.

inputs.name: PairingController.constructor.rate
inputs.description: RateLimitService counts every public pairing call in the pairing bucket against relayConfig.pairingCalls. If hit() returns false, handle returns 429 rate-limited before action dispatch.

inputs.name: PairingController.constructor.access
inputs.description: PairingAccessService supplies info and poll values and handles validated pairing requests. Missing info or poll values and a request result of not-found return 404; other string request results return 409.

inputs.name: PairingController.constructor.exchanges
inputs.description: PairingExchangeService performs the exchange using the route pairingId and the PairingBodyValidator verifier result. A truthy result returns 200, while a falsy result returns 400 pairing-invalid.

inputs.name: PairingController.handle.request
inputs.description: Fetch API Request whose JSON body is read for every action except info. A missing body returns 400 for poll and request actions; exchange passes the verifier result to the exchange service and returns 400 pairing-invalid when that result is falsy.

inputs.name: PairingController.handle.route
inputs.description: Pairing route descriptor with kind, path, hostId, pairingId, and action fields. handle dispatches info, exchange, and poll explicitly and sends every other action through request validation.

outputs.name: PairingController.handle
outputs.description: Fetch API response produced for the route after the host and rate-limit gates and action handling. Status and body depend on the handler result, including 404 and 429 gate responses.
